paragraphs.text: First-party DeepSeek Harness plugins for the sai Android coding agent

First-party DeepSeek Harness plugins used by the sai Android shell. Publish this repository with
the

exact GitHub topic `dsh-plugin`. Packages are independently versioned and ship prebuilt
JavaScript,
so installation never needs a lifecycle build script.

Android is the authority for OS permissions, secrets, microphone capture and foreground services.

ovider and GitHub credentials are never exposed to plugins.
